# Inbox triage — Tuesday 14 April 2026

*These are proposed actions and ready-to-send drafts; no replies, refunds, bookings or system changes have been carried out.*

## 1. Triage

| Message | Category | Priority | Action | Does owner Jane need to decide? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **1. Jane Doe — customer** | Class availability / possible booking change | Medium — before Saturday | Explain that 18 April is full. Offer the 23 April evening option, which currently has exactly three spaces. Confirm her preference before changing anything. | **Yes:** approve transferring her two existing bookings if she wants the evening class; transfer terms are not specified in policy. |
| **2. Richard Roe** | Studio-cancelled class / refund | High — overdue resolution | Arrange the full **$65 refund**. Explain the studio cancellation and bounced notice; confirm his correct email address. | **No:** full refund is required by policy and is his requested remedy. |
| **3. Mary Major** | Wholesale enquiry | Medium — deadline-sensitive | Quote **$23.40 per logo mug; $1,404 for 60**. Explain that 1 May is outside the six-week lead time. Check production availability before accepting. | No for the standard quote. **Yes** for any pricing or lead-time exception, subject to feasibility. |
| **4. “Store Support”** | Suspected phishing | High — security | Do not reply, click or provide payment details. Report as phishing and block the sender. Check account status only through the usual Shopfront login. | **No.** Escalate immediately if anyone already interacted with it. |
| **5. John Stiles** | Shipping damage / missed complaint | High — service recovery | Acknowledge the unread 27 March DM and photo. Offer a free replacement or refund; ask which he prefers. | **No:** the original report qualifies under policy. Any extra goodwill gesture would need approval. |

## 2. Ready-to-send replies

### 1. Customer Jane Doe

Hi Jane,

We’d love to welcome your sister! Unfortunately, Saturday 18 April at 10am is fully booked, so we can’t add another person to that session.

There is an evening wheel-throwing intro on Thursday 23 April at 6:30pm, with three spaces currently available—enough for all of you.

Would you prefer to keep your two Saturday places, or would you like us to check arrangements for moving those bookings to Thursday and adding your sister? We’ll confirm any booking changes and costs with you first.

For now, your Saturday booking is unchanged.

Warmly,  
Kiln & Thistle

### 2. Richard Roe

Hi Richard,

There’s no need to apologise—we actually cancelled the 4 April glaze workshop on 2 April because of a kiln repair. Our cancellation email bounced, and I’m sorry we didn’t follow up another way.

You’re entitled to a full refund because we cancelled the class, so we’ll arrange the full **$65 refund** you’ve requested. Your cancellation timing doesn’t affect that.

Could you also confirm that the email address you’re writing from is the best one for your booking record? We want to make sure future updates reach you.

We’re sorry for the confusion and the missed communication.

Warmly,  
Kiln & Thistle

### 3. Mary Major

Hi Mary,

Thanks for thinking of us for your café—and congratulations on the opening!

For 60 mugs, our wholesale price is **$20.40 per mug**, plus **$3 each** for your café logo. That comes to **$23.40 per mug, or $1,404 for 60**. Your order meets our 48-unit minimum, but we can’t meet $18 each under our standard pricing.

Our lead time is six weeks, so we also can’t meet delivery by 1 May. From today, six weeks takes us to **26 May**, with the actual schedule and delivery date still needing confirmation against existing commitments.

If a later delivery at that price could work, we’d be happy to review your logo and check production availability.

Warmly,  
Kiln & Thistle

### 5. John Stiles

Hi John,

I’m really sorry we left you waiting, especially after your mug arrived cracked.

We found your Instagram message and photo from 27 March about order #1042. You reported the damage two days after delivery, so you were well within our seven-day reporting window. You don’t need to resend the photo.

We can offer you a **free replacement or a refund**, whichever you prefer. Please let us know your choice and we’ll arrange the next steps.

We should have picked up your first message, and I’m sorry you had to chase us.

Warmly,  
Kiln & Thistle

**Message 4:** No reply—suspected phishing.

## 3. Internal notes and approvals

### Booking and customer-record fixes
- **Customer Jane:** Saturday is **8/8**; Thursday is **5/8**. Moving her two bookings and adding her sister would make Thursday **8/8** and Saturday **6/8**. Recheck availability before confirming.
- **Owner approval needed:** terms for transferring the two existing places; no transfer policy is supplied. The sister needs a third paid booking at the applicable class price, which is not provided.
- If she instead cancels Saturday today, that is **four days before class**, so the customer-cancellation policy gives a **50% refund**. Confirm the amount paid before calculating dollars.
- **Richard:** refund **$65**, not a late-cancellation percentage. The studio cancelled. Confirm and correct the address currently recorded as `richard.reo@example.com`; do not guess the replacement address.
- Add a bounced-email queue and manual follow-up for studio cancellations.

### Damage claim and shared-inbox coverage
- Link John’s **27 March Instagram DM and photo** to order #1042. Delivery was **25 March**; the report was within seven days, regardless of when staff read it.
- Ask only for his remedy preference. Verify the actual amount paid before processing a refund; the **$34 retail price** alone does not establish the order’s refund total.
- Assign a daily owner and backup for email and social DMs, with unresolved cases tracked centrally.

### Wholesale figures and capacity
- **$34 × 60% = $20.40** wholesale base price.
- **60 × $20.40 = $1,224**, plus **60 × $3 = $180** for logos: **$1,404 total**.
- Mary’s offer totals **$1,080**, a **$324 shortfall**.
- At **40 wholesale mugs/week**, 60 mugs require capacity across at least **two production weeks**. That does not override the **six-week lead time**.
- **1 May is only 17 days away.** Do not promise a rush order. Confirm existing kiln commitments and shipping timing before committing to a later date.

### Security
- The sender does not match genuine Shopfront mail: `no-reply@shopfront.example.com`.
- If anyone entered credentials or payment details, immediately escalate, secure the account through the known login, and contact the payment provider as appropriate.
